summary.name: Rukovoditel
summary.one_liner: Rukovoditel is a free, open-source, web-based application builder for project management, task management, and other business apps such as CRM, ERP, HRM, or WMS, built with PHP and MySQL.
use_cases: Set up project and task management for a startup
Build a custom CRM, ERP, or HRM system
Manage documents and finances alongside projects
Host an internal project tracker on a local server
Import existing data from Excel into a business app
summary.what_it_does: Rukovoditel lets you create your own web-based business application by designing entities, fields, and relationships with a visual designer, without programming. The default configuration splits work into projects and tasks, and you can add more entities such as documents or finances as the company grows. It supports process automation, customizable list and form appearance, user access rights by group, and importing data from Excel files. Each user can build their own reports. It can be installed on an internal server, on common web hosting, or run on a local PC without a network.
notable: Visual designer for building custom entities and relationships without coding
Configurable beyond project management: CRM, ERP, HRM, WMS, etc.
Each user can create their own reports
caveats: Requires PHP 8.0.2 or newer and MySQL
An 'Extension' package with additional reports and planning tools is offered separately; its contents are not listed on the page
Operating system support beyond the web/PHP/MySQL stack is not stated on the page
